Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has two pairs of parallel sides and all four sides equal. What is the most specific name? ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapezoid~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: Four equal sides and two parallel pairs identify a rhombus. Right angles are not guaranteed, so rectangle cannot be inferred.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. The two non-parallel sides are not the same length. What is the most specific name? ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapezoid~~
Solution: Exactly one parallel pair makes this a trapezoid. A parallelogram, rectangle or rhombus has two parallel pairs. The legs are unequal, so it is not an isosceles trapezoid.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. The two non-parallel sides are not the same length. What is the most specific name? ~~Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapezoid | Isosceles-trapezoid~~
Solution: Exactly one parallel pair makes this a trapezoid. A parallelogram, rectangle or rhombus has two parallel pairs. The stated nonparallel sides are unequal. An isosceles trapezoid requires equal legs, so the original isosceles key was incorrect.

Question Choices: A quadrilateral has: all sides equal and all angles are right angles. What is the most specific name?
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: A square has four equal sides and four right angles. Therefore it is a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. The most specific name is square.

Question Choices: Fill: A parallelogram has four sides, so it belongs to the four-sided polygon family called a __.
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: A parallelogram has four straight sides, so it belongs to the four-sided polygon family called quadrilateral.

Question Choices: Select. Is a rectangle always a rhombus? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: No. A rectangle with side lengths 3,5,3,5 has four right angles but not four equal sides, so it is not a rhombus or square.

Question Choices: Select which of the following shapes are always rhombuses? ~~Square | Quadrilateral | Parallelogram~~
Solution: A square always has four equal sides, so it is a rhombus. A general quadrilateral or parallelogram need not have four equal sides.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "Every square is a rectangle, but not every rectangle is a square" ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: Every square has four right angles, so it is a rectangle. A 3 by 5 rectangle is not a square because its adjacent sides differ. Both claims hold, so TRUE.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "Square meets the rules for rectangle, rhombus, and parallelogram" ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: A square has four equal sides and four right angles. Therefore it is a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. All three named definitions are satisfied, so TRUE.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral is a rhombus, but not a square. What must be true about its angles? ~~all-right-angles | not-all-right-angles | all-equal-angles~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: A rhombus already has four equal sides. If it also had four right angles it would be a square. Since it is not a square, its angles are not all right angles.
